title.narrative: Health Assessment Programme Support for USRAP from Middle East and North Africa

description.narrative: The project conducts refugee health activities required per CDC Technical instructions, with the purpose of safe refugee resettlement from Middle East & North Africa region to USA. This support includes refugee health assessments, immunization, treatment, referrals, fitness to travel and medical movement support. Activities are part of the United States Refugee Admissions Program (USRAP), sanctioned and funded by the State Department (Bureau of Population, Refugees, and Migration - BPRM).

sector.narrative: Migration Health Assessment and Travel Assistance
